title: Regional Field Marketing, India
description:
ClickHouse is hiring for our Regional Field Marketing, India role to lead our regional field marketing strategy in India. This is a foundational role responsible for building awareness, generating pipeline, and accelerating revenue in the region.
  
  
In this role, your mission will be to define and scale the India regional field marketing engine. You will own the regional field marketing strategy, partner closely with India sales leadership, and adapt global campaigns to the needs of the India market. You will be measured on enterprise pipeline and self-service revenue (MRR), working across both our self-serve product-led motion and our sales-led enterprise motion.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own the India regional field marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget, aligning field programs to regional pipeline and revenue targets with sales leadership.
* Act as the marketing counterpart to India sales leadership, joining regional forecasting, QBRs, and account planning so marketing investment maps to sales priorities.
* Partner with demand generation and growth to build programs for strategic verticals and AI-native sales teams, and to convert self-serve usage into commercial pipeline and expansion revenue.
* Build an integrated regional program mix spanning first-party hosted events, third-party conferences, virtual events, ABM plays, digital advertising, and partner marketing.
* Adapt global campaigns, messaging, and content for the India market.
* Establish scalable processes for campaign planning, lead management, and follow-up with marketing operations and global demand generation, so every program has a clear path from engagement to pipeline. Report on pipeline generated and influenced revenue.
* Identify emerging opportunities across India, make the case for new investment in geographies, verticals, or channels, and represent the region in global planning cycles.

**What You Bring Along**

* 10+ years of experience in field, regional, or integrated marketing within the database, data analytics, infrastructure, or developer tooling space
* Deep experience marketing in India
* Demonstrated success owning a pipeline number and driving measurable revenue impact through regional marketing programs
* Proven ability to partner with sales leadership at the VP level
* Experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed organization, collaborating across time zones
* Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Able to travel at least 2 times per month across India

**Perks**

* Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
* Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
* Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
* Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
* A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
* Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It
  
  
As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
  
  
Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Unit Head
description:
Unit Head – Credit Line on UPI
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Unit Head will own the end-to-end business performance of the Credit Line on UPI (CLoU) portfolio. This includes growth strategy, acquisition funnels, partner ecosystem management, monetisation, unit economics, and lifecycle optimization.
  
  
The role is deeply P&L-oriented, requiring strong cross-functional collaboration with product, risk, operations, finance, and partner-bank teams to drive scalable and sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Growth & Strategy
* Own overall business performance for Credit Line on UPI—including lines created, active users, activation %, throughput, and revenue generation.
* Craft the go-to-market (GTM) strategy across target customer segments (merchant & consumer), use cases, and distribution channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow P2M adoption, repeat usage, frequency, and wallet share.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory context to shape business priorities.
* Ensure predictable, controllable growth aligned with portfolio health and partner expectations.
* Partner & Ecosystem Management
* Manage relationships with partner LSPs, PSPs, TPAPs, distribution partners, and ecosystem players.
* Drive partner onboarding, integration planning, scale-up, and ongoing performance management.
* Align incentives, revenue models, and commercial structures to optimise partner throughput and profitability.
* Lead governance forums with partners—reviewing business volumes, operational issues, funnel leakages, risk metrics, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure stable and high-performing partnerships that enable predictable business scaling.
* Acquisition & Post-Acquisition Ownership
* Work with growth, marketing, product, and channel partners to optimise acquisition funnels end-to-end.
* Identify drop-off points across onboarding, activation, and early-usage stages; drive initiatives to improve activation and engagement.
* Own lifecycle interventions post-acquisition—nudges, journeys, campaigns, and partner-led programs to improve usage and repeat transactions.
* Drive funnel improvements that translate into higher active base, improved retention, and stronger unit economics.
* Revenue, Monetisation & Unit Economics
* Own all monetisation levers including interchange, MDR, interest income, late fees, and partner-linked revenue streams.
* Analyse and manage CAC, cost-to-serve, collection efficiency, risk-adjusted contribution margin, and overall P&L sustainability.
* Balance growth with portfolio quality, working closely with Risk teams to maintain controlled delinquency and financial discipline.
* Build revenue forecasts, P&L models, and commercial scenarios for planning and partner negotiations.
* Ensure strong visibility into revenue performance, profitability, and economic drivers across customer cohorts.
* Data, Analytics & Performance Management
* Monitor dashboards tracking lines created, activations, active users, repeat usage, transaction value, risk metrics, and revenue.
* Identify performance patterns and proactively address early-warning signals related to risk, conversion, or partner issues.
* Lead business reviews with leadership, presenting insights, strategic decisions, and data-driven action plans.
* Drive controlled experiments, pilots, and A/B tests to unlock new segments, use cases, and monetisation opportunities.
* Use analytics to forecast performance, optimise growth levers, and improve portfolio profitability.

**The Role**

Our tech team has automated most of the repeatable, standard-process work: reminders, document chasers, scheduling nudges. What's left is the part that actually needs a human, catching the situation that doesn't fit the standard flow, and making the right call on it.

You'll sit between clients and advisors, watching for the moments automation can't handle: a client going quiet before a renewal, an advisor stuck on an unusual case, a process that's technically "done" but the outcome doesn't feel right. You fix it, and you tell the tech team what to build next.

* Handle the exceptions, escalations, and judgment calls that fall outside our automated workflows
* Watch client and advisor journeys for early signs of something going sideways, before it becomes a problem
* Design and implement playbooks for repeatable, efficient client-advisor interactions
* Step in directly with clients or advisors when a human touch actually matters
* Work closely with the tech team: flag what should be automated next, and test what they build
* Own the edge cases and one-off requests that don't have a system built for them yet

**Who We're Looking For**

* Sharp judgment: knows the difference between "follow the process" and "this needs a real decision"
* Comfortable being the last line of defence when automation doesn't cover it
* Clear communicator, equally at ease with clients, advisors, and the tech team
* Curious about where the real gaps are, not just executing what's already defined
* Calm under pressure, especially when several things need attention at once

**Qualifications**

***Preferred***

* Prior exposure to financial services, wealth management, or fintech

**What You'll Get**

* Real ownership of the human layer of client experience, not busywork the tech team has already solved

**The Experience**
We are looking for Senior Technical Consultants with strong domain depth in Revenue Cloud or Comms or Fins or Health. Depth in one of the four is what we require.
  
  
You will lead a work stream in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements as a hands-on advisor: designing the solution, guiding the build, and presenting and defending it with the customer. You will lead the evaluation of options, proactively manage risk, and see issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Lead the technical design and delivery of a work stream within your domain.
* Drive application and technical design documents that follow Salesforce best practices and fit the customer's landscape.
* Guide the team on integration, environment management, testing and platform standards.
* Troubleshoot critical implementation issues through to resolution.
* Manage customer expectations and negotiate solutions with the customer and third-party partners.
* Mentor junior teammates and contribute to the growth of the Services Practice.
* Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-native delivery, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g. Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude).
